name: Guillam Matisse
source:
Art Dealer, Kalmia Art Gallery Japan.

"By being completely taken with expressing art in a single way, you are forgetting about the world."

Confident and ambitious, but also a bit of a flirt and is sometimes shallow. His level of Japanese is good enough to carry out everday conversation without trouble, but he occasionally slips up. He initially came to Japan on a work-cum-holiday trip but ended up staying due to various job-related reasons. Passionate about the arts and his career, he is a firm believer of mixing business with pleasure.

[From [url=https://precatio.wordpress.com/characters/]official site[/url]]
